prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied Megumi portrait into a lightly colored line-art illustration suitable for an application icon. Preserve the exact character identity, calm gentle closed-mouth smile, eye shape, hairstyle, slim headband, three-quarter head angle, sailor uniform, necktie, proportions and head-and-shoulders composition. Use clear, moderately bold dark slate-blue outlines, with a slightly stronger outer contour. Fill the hair with a very light warm gray-brown, the face and neck with opaque warm ivory, the clothing with pale gray-blue, the collar with ivory, and the necktie with muted burgundy. Keep the eyes warm brown and use only a touch of pale pink on the cheeks. These must be genuine opaque pale color fills inside the portrait, not transparent empty areas. The effect should be refined colored linework with restrained flat pastel fills: no heavy dark hair mass, no glossy anime shading, no gradients, no crosshatching, no paper texture. Reduce fine stray hair lines and use a small number of clean meaningful contours so the image stays clear when reduced. Preserve the source's natural portrait proportions, do not make it chibi. Transparent alpha background outside the person's silhouette only. Keep the head and shoulders fully inside the square canvas with some breathing room. No circular badge, no frame, no text, no swatches, no mockup, no checkerboard background. Deliver ONE finished portrait asset; the light/dark comparison will be displayed separately.
